q.en: Is it bad to feel angry?
q.hg: Kya gussa aana buri baat hai?

a.en: No. Feeling angry is okay. Everyone feels angry sometimes. But hitting, biting or breaking things is not okay. When you feel angry, stop and take five slow breaths. Then tell a grown-up you trust what made you angry. They can help.
a.hg: Nahi. Gussa aana theek hai. Sabko kabhi-kabhi gussa aata hai. Lekin maarna, kaatna ya cheezein todna theek nahi hai. Jab gussa aaye, toh ruko aur paanch dheemi saansein lo. Phir kisi bharose wale bade ko batao ki gussa kis baat par aaya. Woh help kar sakte hain.

q.en: I feel sad and I do not know why. What should I do?
q.hg: Main udaas hoon aur mujhe pata nahi kyun. Main kya karoon?

a.en: It is okay to feel sad, even when you do not know the reason. You can cry. You can hug someone you love. You can draw or play outside. And tell a grown-up you trust, like Mummy, Papa or your teacher: 'I feel sad.' If the sad feeling stays for many days, tell them again.
a.hg: Udaas hona theek hai, tab bhi jab wajah pata na ho. Tum ro sakte ho. Jisse pyaar karte ho usse hug kar sakte ho. Drawing kar sakte ho ya bahar khel sakte ho. Aur kisi bharose wale bade ko batao, jaise Mummy, Papa ya teacher: 'Main udaas hoon.' Agar udaasi kai dinon tak rahe, toh unhe phir se batao.

q.en: Everyone in my class looks more grown up than me. Is something wrong with me?
q.hg: Class mein sab mujhse zyada grown up dikhte hain. Kya mujh mein kuch gadbad hai?

a.en: Almost certainly not. Puberty can start anywhere between 8 and 13 in girls and between 9 and 14 in boys, so classmates of the same age can look years apart. Late starters catch up, and starting later does not make your adult body any less normal. Feeling left behind is one of the most common puberty worries. See a doctor if there are no signs at all by 13 for girls or 14 for boys, mostly for reassurance. Until then, tell a parent or another adult you trust how it feels.
a.hg: Nahi, almost pakka hai ki tum mein kuch gadbad nahi hai. Puberty ladkiyon mein 8 se 13 aur ladkon mein 9 se 14 saal ke beech kabhi bhi shuru ho sakti hai, isliye ek hi age ke classmates dekhne mein kai saal chhote-bade lag sakte hain. Late shuru karne wale bhi catch up kar lete hain, aur late shuru hone se tumhari adult body kam normal nahi hoti. Peeche chhoot jaane ki feeling puberty ki sabse common tensions mein se ek hai. Agar ladkiyon mein 13 aur ladkon mein 14 saal tak koi bhi sign na dikhe, toh doctor ko dikhao, zyadatar tasalli ke liye. Tab tak parents ya kisi trusted adult ko batao ki tumhe kaisa lag raha hai.

q.en: People tease me about my weight and skin colour. How do I stop feeling bad about my body?
q.hg: Log mere weight aur rang ko lekar chidhate hain. Main apni body ko lekar bura feel karna kaise band karoon?

a.en: Start here: the teasing is the problem, not your body. Comments about weight, height or skin colour are bullying, and no body deserves that. Bodies come in many sizes and shades, and dark skin, thin bodies and fat bodies are all normal. You may still feel hurt, which is natural. Tell a parent or teacher what is being said and by whom; you do not have to fix it alone. Spend time with people who are kind to you, and notice what your body can do. If you start skipping meals or avoiding school, tell an adult or call 1098.
a.hg: Shuruaat yahan se karo: problem chidhane mein hai, tumhari body mein nahi. Weight, height ya rang par comments bullying hain, aur koi bhi body yeh deserve nahi karti. Bodies kai sizes aur kai shades ki hoti hain, aur saanwla rang, patli body aur moti body, sab normal hain. Phir bhi bura lag sakta hai, aur yeh natural hai. Parents ya teacher ko batao ki kya bola ja raha hai aur kaun bol raha hai; isse akele fix karna tumhara kaam nahi hai. Un logon ke saath time bitao jo tumhare saath kind hain, aur notice karo ki tumhari body kya-kya kar sakti hai. Agar tum khana skip karne lago ya school jaane se bachne lago, toh kisi bade ko batao ya 1098 par call karo.

q.en: Why do I cry or get angry so easily these days?
q.hg: Aajkal mujhe itni jaldi rona ya gussa kyun aa jaata hai?

a.en: During puberty, hormone changes and a fast-developing brain make emotions stronger and quicker to switch. Add less sleep, school pressure and friendship drama, and small things can feel huge. This is common and does not mean something is wrong with you. Sleep, food, exercise and naming the feeling out loud all take the edge off. Talk to a trusted adult or call Tele-MANAS on 14416 if the low or angry mood stays on most days for two weeks or more, stops you from doing normal things, or comes with thoughts of hurting yourself.
a.hg: Puberty ke dauraan hormone changes aur tezi se develop hota dimaag emotions ko zyada strong aur jaldi switch hone wala bana dete hain. Upar se kam neend, school ka pressure aur friendship drama jud jaaye, toh chhoti baatein bhi bahut badi lagne lagti hain. Yeh common hai aur iska matlab yeh nahi ki tum mein kuch gadbad hai. Neend, khana, exercise aur feeling ka naam zor se bolna, yeh sab iski dhaar kam karte hain. Agar low ya gusse wala mood do hafte ya usse zyada time tak lagbhag har din rahe, normal kaam rok de, ya khud ko hurt karne ke thoughts aayein, toh kisi trusted adult se baat karo ya Tele-MANAS 14416 par call karo.

q.en: My crush said no and now I feel worthless. Is this normal?
q.hg: Mere crush ne mana kar diya aur ab mujhe lagta hai main worthless hoon. Kya yeh normal hai?

a.en: Yes, the hurt is normal, and no, you are not worthless. Rejection stings sharply and usually fades over days or weeks. A 'no' means that person does not feel the same way; it says nothing about your value or your future. Respect the answer: do not keep asking, follow them around or send messages through friends. Let yourself feel sad, talk to someone you trust, and keep doing things you are good at. If the worthless feeling stays for more than two weeks, or you think of harming yourself, tell a trusted adult or call 14416.
a.hg: Haan, hurt hona normal hai, aur nahi, tum worthless nahi ho. Rejection tez chubhta hai aur aam taur par kuch dinon ya hafton mein halka pad jaata hai. 'No' ka matlab bas itna hai ki us insaan ko waisa feel nahi hota; yeh tumhari value ya tumhare future ke baare mein kuch nahi kehta. Jawab ki respect karo: baar-baar mat poochho, peechha mat karo aur friends ke through messages mat bhijwao. Khud ko sad hone do, kisi bharose wale se baat karo, aur woh kaam karte raho jinme tum achhe ho. Agar worthless wali feeling do hafte se zyada rahe, ya khud ko harm karne ka thought aaye, toh kisi trusted adult ko batao ya 14416 par call karo.

q.en: My friends tease me because I have never had a girlfriend or boyfriend or 'done anything'. Am I behind?
q.hg: Mere friends chidhate hain kyunki meri kabhi girlfriend ya boyfriend nahi rahi aur maine 'kuch kiya' nahi. Kya main baaki sab se peeche hoon?

a.en: No. There is no schedule you are late for. Many people your age have never dated or had any sexual experience, and friends often exaggerate their own stories. Not being interested yet, or deciding to wait, is a normal and valid choice. Under Indian law a person under 18 cannot legally consent to sexual activity, so nobody should be pushing you towards it. You can say, 'I am fine with where I am,' and change the subject. Friends who keep mocking you after that are applying pressure, not friendship.
a.hg: Nahi. Aisa koi schedule nahi hai jisme tum late ho. Tumhari age ke bahut se logon ne kabhi date nahi kiya aur unhe koi sexual experience nahi hai, aur friends aksar apni stories badha-chadhakar sunate hain. Abhi interest na hona, ya wait karne ka decision lena, normal aur valid choice hai. Indian law mein 18 se kam umar ka person sexual activity ke liye legally consent nahi de sakta, isliye kisi ko bhi tumhe is taraf push nahi karna chahiye. Tum bol sakte ho, 'Main jahan hoon, wahan theek hoon,' aur topic change kar sakte ho. Iske baad bhi jo friends mazaak udate rahein, woh dosti nahi nibha rahe, pressure daal rahe hain.

q.en: Sometimes I think everyone would be better off without me. What should I do?
q.hg: Kabhi-kabhi lagta hai ki mere bina sab better rahenge. Main kya karoon?

a.en: Thank you for saying it. This thought is a sign that you are carrying too much pain, not a sign that it is true. Please do not stay alone with it. Tell a trusted adult today, in plain words: 'I have been thinking about not being alive.' Call Tele-MANAS on 14416 at any hour, or 112 if you feel you might act on the thought. Stay near someone you trust until you have spoken to a helper. These feelings can ease with support, even when that seems impossible right now. You deserve that help.
a.hg: Yeh bolne ke liye thank you. Yeh thought is baat ka sign hai ki tum bahut zyada dard utha rahe ho, is baat ka nahi ki yeh sach hai. Iske saath akele mat raho. Aaj hi kisi trusted adult ko seedhe shabdon mein batao: 'Mujhe zinda na rehne ke thoughts aa rahe hain.' Tele-MANAS 14416 par kisi bhi time call karo, ya agar lage ki tum is thought par kuch kar baithoge toh 112 par call karo. Jab tak kisi helper se baat na ho jaaye, kisi bharose wale insaan ke paas raho. Support milne par yeh feelings halki ho sakti hain, bhale hi abhi yeh impossible lage. Tum yeh help deserve karte ho.

q.en: How do I know if my relationship is emotionally abusive or we just fight a lot?
q.hg: Kaise pata chale ki mera relationship emotionally abusive hai ya hum bas bahut jhagadte hain?

a.en: Look at the pattern and at how you feel. In ordinary fights, both people can speak, both can say sorry, and you are not afraid. In emotional abuse, one person repeatedly controls the other: insults, checking your phone, deciding whom you meet, threats, blaming you for everything, making you doubt your memory. Ask yourself: am I scared of their reaction? Have I stopped seeing friends? Do I apologise constantly? If yes, talk to a trusted adult or counsellor, or call 14416; girls can call 181 and anyone under 18 can call 1098. It is not your fault.
a.hg: Pattern ko dekho aur yeh dekho ki tumhe kaisa feel hota hai. Normal fights mein dono bol paate hain, dono sorry bol paate hain, aur tumhe darr nahi lagta. Emotional abuse mein ek insaan baar-baar doosre ko control karta hai: insult, phone check karna, yeh decide karna ki tum kisse miloge, dhamkiyan, har baat ka blame tum par daalna, tumhe apni hi memory par shak karana. Khud se poochho: kya mujhe uske reaction se darr lagta hai? Kya maine friends se milna chhod diya hai? Kya mujhe har waqt sorry bolna padta hai? Agar haan, toh kisi trusted adult ya counsellor se baat karo, ya 14416 par call karo; ladkiyan 181 par aur 18 se kam umar ka koi bhi 1098 par call kar sakta hai. Isme tumhari galti nahi hai.

q.en: It has been weeks since my breakup and I still cannot focus. How long will this last?
q.hg: Breakup ko hafte ho gaye aur abhi bhi focus nahi hota. Yeh kab tak chalega?

a.en: There is no fixed timeline. For most people the sharpest pain eases over several weeks, with good days and sudden bad ones mixed together. Sleep and concentration suffer because your mind is grieving. What helps recovery: routine, exercise, talking honestly to a friend, and a break from checking their profile. Avoid using alcohol as a painkiller and avoid contacting them again and again. Get support from a counsellor or Tele-MANAS on 14416 if you cannot manage studies or work after a few weeks, or if hopeless thoughts or thoughts of self-harm appear.
a.hg: Iski koi fixed timeline nahi hai. Zyadatar logon mein sabse tez dard kuch hafton mein halka padta hai, aur beech-beech mein achhe din aur achanak bure din dono aate hain. Neend aur concentration isliye bigadte hain kyunki mann grieve kar raha hai. Recovery mein kya help karta hai: routine, exercise, kisi friend se honestly baat karna, aur uski profile check karne se kuch din ka break. Alcohol ko painkiller ki tarah use mat karo aur usse baar-baar contact mat karo. Agar kuch hafton baad bhi padhai ya kaam na sambhle, ya hopeless thoughts ya self-harm ke thoughts aayein, toh counsellor ya Tele-MANAS 14416 se support lo.

q.en: Counsellor, psychologist or psychiatrist: what is the difference and whom should I see?
q.hg: Counsellor, psychologist ya psychiatrist: inme kya fark hai aur mujhe kiske paas jaana chahiye?

a.en: A counsellor and a clinical psychologist mainly use talking therapies; a psychologist can also do detailed assessments. A psychiatrist is a medical doctor who can diagnose, prescribe medicines and also offer therapy. If you are unsure, start with whoever is easiest to reach: a college or workplace counsellor, a government hospital psychiatry OPD, or Tele-MANAS on 14416, which can guide you to the right level of care. Go straight to a psychiatrist or an emergency department if there are thoughts of suicide, or if you cannot sleep, eat or function. It is fine to change professionals if the fit is poor.
a.hg: Counsellor aur clinical psychologist mainly talking therapies use karte hain; psychologist detailed assessments bhi kar sakte hain. Psychiatrist medical doctor hote hain jo diagnose kar sakte hain, medicines prescribe kar sakte hain aur therapy bhi de sakte hain. Agar samajh na aaye, toh usse shuru karo jis tak pahunchna sabse easy ho: college ya office ka counsellor, government hospital ki psychiatry OPD, ya Tele-MANAS 14416, jo tumhe sahi level ki care tak guide kar sakta hai. Agar suicide ke thoughts hon, ya tum so, kha ya function na kar pa rahe ho, toh seedhe psychiatrist ya emergency department jao. Agar kisi professional ke saath fit na baithe, toh change kar lena bilkul theek hai.

q.en: My friend told me they are hurting themselves and made me promise not to tell anyone. What do I do?
q.hg: Mere friend ne bataya ki woh khud ko hurt kar raha hai aur mujhse promise liya ki kisi ko nahi bataunga. Main kya karoon?

a.en: Take it seriously and do not carry it alone. A promise of secrecy should not be kept when someone's safety is at risk. Tell your friend kindly: 'I care about you too much to keep this secret; let us tell someone together.' Then inform a trusted adult, such as a parent, teacher or counsellor, or call Tele-MANAS on 14416. If your friend is in immediate danger, call 112 and stay with them. Listen without judging, and do not ask for details or promise to fix it. Your friend may be upset at first; getting them help is still the caring choice.
a.hg: Isse seriously lo aur isse akele mat dhoo. Jab kisi ki safety risk mein ho, toh secret rakhne ka promise nahi nibhana chahiye. Apne friend se pyaar se bolo: 'Mujhe tumhari itni parwah hai ki main yeh secret nahi rakh sakta; chalo saath mein kisi ko batate hain.' Phir kisi trusted adult ko batao, jaise parent, teacher ya counsellor, ya Tele-MANAS 14416 par call karo. Agar friend turant danger mein ho, toh 112 par call karo aur uske saath raho. Bina judge kiye suno, details mat poochho aur sab fix kar dene ka promise mat karo. Friend shuru mein upset ho sakta hai; phir bhi usse help dilana hi caring choice hai.

keywords: dost khud ko hurt karta hai

q.en: I go to the gym every day but still feel small and skinny, and I am thinking about taking steroids. Is something wrong with me?
q.hg: Main roz gym jaata hoon, phir bhi khud ko chhota aur dubla feel karta hoon, aur steroids lene ki soch raha hoon. Kya mujhme kuch gadbad hai?

a.en: Wanting to be fit is healthy. But feeling small despite training, checking mirrors constantly, panicking over a missed workout or arranging life around gym and diet can be signs of muscle dysmorphia, a form of body dysmorphic disorder more common in boys and men. It is a problem of body image, not of muscle, so more size never settles it. Anabolic steroids carry real risks: severe acne, mood swings and aggression, heart strain, shrunken testicles and reduced fertility, and in teenagers they can stop growth early. Tell a doctor honestly what you feel and take. This is treatable, and asking is not weakness. Tele-MANAS on 14416 can also guide you.
a.hg: Fit rehne ki chaah healthy hai. Lekin kitni bhi training ke baad khud ko chhota hi feel karna, baar-baar mirror check karna, ek workout miss hone pe panic karna ya poori life gym aur diet ke hisaab se chalana muscle dysmorphia ke signs ho sakte hain, jo body dysmorphic disorder ka ek form hai aur ladkon aur men mein zyada dekha jata hai. Yeh body image ki problem hai, muscles ki nahi, isliye size kitna bhi badh jaye, tasalli nahi hoti. Anabolic steroids ke real risks hain: severe acne, mood swings aur aggression, heart pe strain, testicles ka shrink hona aur fertility kam hona, aur teenagers mein yeh growth jaldi rok sakte hain. Doctor ko honestly batao ki tum kya feel karte ho aur kya lete ho. Yeh treatable hai, aur poochna weakness nahi hai. Tele-MANAS 14416 bhi tumhe guide kar sakta hai.

q.en: My friend keeps saying he is a burden and has started giving away his things. I am scared but do not want to overreact. What do I do?
q.hg: Mera dost baar-baar kehta hai ki woh sab pe burden hai aur usne apni cheezein logon ko deni shuru kar di hain. Mujhe darr lag raha hai, par main overreact bhi nahi karna chahta. Main kya karoon?

a.en: You are not overreacting; these are recognised warning signs of suicide. Talk to him privately today and ask plainly: 'Are you thinking about suicide?' Asking does not put the idea in his head; it shows that someone noticed. Listen more than you speak, and do not argue, lecture or promise to keep it secret. If he says yes, stay with him, keep him away from anything he could use to hurt himself, and call Tele-MANAS on 14416 together or bring in a family member or doctor. If he may act soon, call 112 and do not leave him alone. Then tell a trusted adult; you should not carry this alone.
a.hg: Tum overreact nahi kar rahe; yeh suicide ke recognised warning signs hain. Aaj hi usse akele mein baat karo aur seedhe words mein poocho: 'Kya tum suicide ke baare mein soch rahe ho?' Poochne se yeh idea uske dimaag mein nahi baithta; isse use pata chalta hai ki kisi ne notice kiya. Bolo kam, suno zyada, aur argue mat karo, lecture mat do, na hi secret rakhne ka promise karo. Agar woh haan bole, toh uske saath raho, use har us cheez se door rakho jisse woh khud ko hurt kar sakta hai, aur saath milke Tele-MANAS 14416 pe call karo ya family ke kisi member ya doctor ko bulao. Agar lage ki woh jaldi kuch kar sakta hai, toh 112 pe call karo aur use akela mat chhodo. Phir khud bhi kisi trusted adult ko batao; yeh bojh tumhe akele nahi uthana chahiye.

keywords: dost suicide ki baat karta hai
kisi ko suicide se kaise roke

q.en: Something was done to me years ago and I still feel dirty and ashamed, as if it was my fault. Will this feeling ever go away?
q.hg: Saalon pehle mere saath kuch kiya gaya tha aur aaj bhi mujhe ganda aur ashamed feel hota hai, jaise galti meri thi. Kya yeh feeling kabhi jayegi?

a.en: It can ease, and it was not your fault. Whether you froze, stayed silent, went back or your body reacted, responsibility lies with the person who harmed you. Shame after abuse is extremely common in survivors of every gender, and it grows in silence. Telling one safe person, such as a friend, doctor or counsellor, is often the turning point, and trauma-focused therapy helps many. Start with a free call to Tele-MANAS on 14416, or 1098 if under 18; helpers may then need to report it to keep you safe. There is no deadline for healing. If shame turns into thoughts of ending your life, call 14416 or 112 now.
a.hg: Yeh feeling halki ho sakti hai, aur galti tumhari nahi thi. Tumne jo bhi kiya ya nahi kiya, chahe tum freeze ho gaye, chup rahe, dobara wahan gaye ya tumhari body ne react kiya, zimmedaari usi ki hai jisne tumhe harm kiya. Abuse ke baad shame har gender ke survivors mein bahut common hai, aur yeh chuppi mein badhti hai. Kisi ek safe insaan ko batana, jaise koi dost, doctor ya counsellor, aksar turning point hota hai, aur trauma-focused therapy bahut logon ki help karti hai. Tum Tele-MANAS 14416 pe free call se start kar sakte ho, ya 18 se kam ho toh 1098 se, jahan helpers ko tumhe safe rakhne ke liye report karna pad sakta hai. Heal hone ki koi deadline nahi hoti. Agar shame apni jaan lene ke thoughts mein badalne lage, toh abhi 14416 ya 112 pe call karo.
